settings.heading: How to order
settings.text: Order online and choose your date in the cart, or text (604) 652-1930 to order. We confirm every order by text.

settings.title: Pick your feast
settings.text: Choose by headcount on the menu, or use the feast planner.

settings.title: Choose pickup or delivery
settings.text: In the cart, pick pickup or delivery, the date and a preferred time. Add any notes for Nanay.

settings.title: We confirm by text
settings.text: Pay at checkout and we'll text to confirm. Questions? Text (604) 652-1930.

settings.question: Can I order by text?
settings.answer: Yes. Text (604) 652-1930 to order. The feast planner can also write the text for you.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
How do I cook the frozen packs?
settings.answer:
• Defrost in refrigerator overnight.
  • Grill flat on a charcoal grill for best result (propane bbq or stovetop works) on medium-high heat until temperature reaches 75°C (165°F). Chicken inasal 6-8 minutes each side; skewers and liempo 4 minutes each side.
  • Enjoy with garlic spiced vinegar and steamed rice.

settings.question: Can I combine items from different sections?
settings.answer: Yes, everything on the menu can go in one order.

settings.question: Do you have vegetarian or gluten-free options?
settings.answer: Text us at (604) 652-1930 and we'll tell you what fits. Palabok contains pork and dried shrimp; Filipino style spaghetti contains SPAM.
